subject: Confirmation of Flight Booking
body: Dear [Name], We are pleased to confirm your flight booking for your upcoming trip to Paris. Your flight details are as follows: - Departure: [Date & Time] - Arrival: [Date & Time] - Flight Number: [Number] Please ensure you arrive at the airport at least 2 hours before departure. If you have any questions or need assistance, feel free to contact us. We wish you a pleasant journey! Best regards, The Travel Agency
